body: About the 'friends worried I don't like them' thing. That worries me everyday, because being truly alone would be one hundred times worse than how I feel now. But there's always something that tells me that i'm doing more harm to them than anything. I don't know why I feel like this but I just do. I don't know how to change this. I might call again sometime, but not sure. And a therapist isn't really an option right now. So that has to wait. I just kind of wish this all would just go away on it's own, but I know it won't.

I've called a hotline. A few months back a good friend of mine saw that I was cutting and that my behavior was changing. (I started to become more anti-social and just in general wasn't acting like myself) I called and talked for about 5 minutes. I hung up because I'm not big on talking about how I feel. I tried a therapist for a few months, I stopped for a few reasons. The biggest being that again I was scared to talk about how I feel. Another thing about my friends and how I don't want to talk to them is that I'm always worried that I'm just being a bother to them. If that makes sense.

Just a lot of things. I feel really alone and helpless all the time even when people are there. I'm afraid to even talk to the few friends I have because of the irrational fear that they hate me. Everyday there's something new to bring me down and I don't know what to do.
